Précepteur d'Alexandre, il a écrit sur l: Tutor to Alexander, he wrote on logic, physics, biology, politics and rhetoric. He thought women had fewer teeth than men. Bertrand Russell was amused that he never thought to check in his two wives' mouths.
Il enseigne la morale, les rites et l'ar: He taught morality, rites and the art of governing by example. His disciples collected his sayings in the Analects. “What you do not want done to yourself, do not do to others” appears there, five centuries before the Gospels.
Juge et médecin à Cordoue, il commente A: A judge and physician in Córdoba, he commented on Aristotle so completely that the Latins simply called him “the Commentator”. For him, philosophy and religion, properly interpreted, cannot contradict each other. Exiled, his books burned, he was rehabilitated shortly before his death.
Diplomate, juge et historien né à Tunis,: A diplomat, judge and historian born in Tunis, he wrote the Muqaddimah in 1377, an introduction to history. In it he seeks the laws of the rise and fall of dynasties: a group's solidarity carries it to power, then luxury wears it down in three or four generations.
En 1929, à 21 ans, elle est reçue deuxiè: In 1929, at 21, she placed second in the philosophy agrégation, the youngest of her year. Sartre came first, on his second attempt; the jury hesitated to swap them. Twenty years later, The Second Sex: “One is not born, but rather becomes, a woman.”
Pour lui, l'esprit et le corps sont deux: For him, mind and body are two distinct substances, which communicate through the pineal gland, in the middle of the brain. The question of their union has occupied philosophers ever since. His body rests in Saint-Germain-des-Prés; a skull presented as his is kept at the National Museum of Natural History.
Pour lui, une théorie n'est scientifique: For him, a theory is only scientific if you can imagine the observation that would refute it. Astrology, which can accommodate anything, fails the test. In 1946 in Cambridge, Wittgenstein reportedly threatened him with a poker during a debate; the witnesses still disagree about what happened.
